process_lessons.lesson: Measure co-critical common owners rather than serializing parallel duplicated work.
Preserve noisy/negative repetitions; median success does not erase a losing pair.
Do not let parent-only RSS outrank whole-process-tree custody, and do not reuse sampled companion timing.
A scope repair must preserve the exact parent's promoted behavior, not merely remove the newest mutation.
Once a protected seed is merged, stop treating implementation as the primary discovery question; demand whole-product evidence before inventing another nearby mechanism.
Batch topology migration: serial authority edits repeatedly pay the very fanout being repaired.
A configured push trigger is not evidence that the decision-critical workflow actually instantiated. Audit the concrete run set on material product merges before assuming the next receipt exists.
